title: Drone-Based Aerial Reconnaissance
subtitle: Capture target-linked aerial evidence using the existing terrain-scene drone.
description: Operate the existing Drone_Object in the Mars terrain scene, document the approach to the officially submitted Sol 3 target, capture and review at least five camera images, return to the designated takeoff point for a validated landing, and submit an evidence-based report.

operationalLimits.boundaryCenterRule: Midpoint of the resolved existing Drone_TakeoffPoint and official target scene-node positions.
operationalLimits.telemetryModel: PHOBOSIA gameplay simulation; not measured physical or NASA vehicle telemetry.

tasks.title: Complete Drone Flight Operations Briefing
tasks.objective: Review the official target, Sol 4 preparation record, objective, boundary, altitude cap, takeoff/landing procedure, capture requirement, safety limits, and simulation capabilities, then explicitly confirm readiness.
validation: Sol 4 preparation report references that target

tasks.title: Activate Drone Reconnaissance Simulation
tasks.objective: Start the simulation only after resolving the existing drone anchor, takeoff marker, and official target object.

tasks.title: Conduct Aerial Route Reconnaissance
tasks.objective: Operate within the configured boundary and 10 m AGL maximum while capturing at least five non-empty images from the live drone camera.
validation: Flight operates within boundary and altitude limits

tasks.title: Return and Safely Land the Drone
tasks.objective: Return to Drone_TakeoffPoint and explicitly land at low speed near the surface.
validation: Takeoff reference position and ground height satisfy landing tolerances
Drone speed is below landing threshold

tasks.title: Review Aerial Observation Records
tasks.objective: Review the saved images individually with target, position, AGL, heading, flight time, camera view, and preview metadata.
validation: All captured image records match the official target

tasks.title: Submit Sol 5 Aerial Reconnaissance Report
tasks.objective: Submit actual flight statistics, image references, player-described visual observations, uncertainties, and areas for later ground verification.
